Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this match! Mahmudullah's troops go 1-0 up in the series after an emphatic win. The two sides will again meet on 4th August, Wednesday for the second T20I. The match will start at 1800 local (1200GMT). But the build-up will begin much in advance. Do join us for that. Till then, tada!
Nasum Ahmed is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his match-winning figures of 4-0-19-4.

The Bangladesh captain, Mahmudullah, is up for a chat - He says that they were 10-15 runs short. Adds that they executed their plans well. Adds that there needs to be an attacking mindset defending a low total and that's what they did. Mentions that hunger needs to be there in the tank to get a victory and adds that he is focusing on the game tomorrow.

The Australian skipper, Matthew Wade is up for a chat - He says that the bowlers did a terrific job and 132 was certainly getable. Adds that when they lost three wickets early on, they tried to rebuild the innings but weren't able to. Says he's disappointed that they got bowled out for such a low total. Mentions that he knew that Bangladesh were going to attack us with spin and when our bowlers gave us a chance for getting 132, our batters should  have chased it. Mentions that the wickets in West Indies spun a lot more and here the ball skidded on and they came to Bangladesh confident but just didn't execute their plans well.

Australia were in all sorts of trouble at the start! Alex Carey was sent back to the pavilion on the first ball off the innings. Josh Phillipe and Moises Henriques also followed him and Australia found themselves at 11/3. Repair work had to be done after that. Mitchell Marsh and the skipper, Matthew Wade then took the responsibility on their shoulders. The rescue job however failed as Wade's struggle came to an end. Marsh then stood like a rock alone but in the end, ran out of patience as he was undone on 45. After that, there was no sting in the Australian tail as they got bundled out for 108! A straightforward chase turned out to be a pretty frustrating one for the Australians.

Mahmudullah and his tigers have pulled of a famous victory! Their first over Australia in a T20I match! Mahedi Hasan provided Bangladesh the dream start as he removed Carey off his first ball. Nasum Ahmed and Shakib Al Hasan also joined the party and chipped in with a wicket each. Australia were put on the back foot right away and they struggled to keep the scoreboard ticking. Nasum Ahmed got the better of Wade as he scalped him in his comeback spell and then went on to pick up four wickets including the big fish, Mitchell Marsh. Bangladesh were relentless with the ball and Mustafizur Rahman and Shoriful Islam cleaned up the Australian tail as they picked up a couple of wickets each to bundle Australia out for 108!

OUT! TIMBER! Mustafizur Rahman finishes things off! A sharp incoming delivery on off, Mitchell Starc looks to drive but is completely beaten. The ball goes through his bat and dislodges the off stump. Australia are bundled out for 108 and BANGLADESH WIN BY 23 RUNS! What a moment for them!
Full toss again on off, Josh Hazlewood knocks it to extra cover for a run.
Full toss on off, Starc pushes it towards covers for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Starc swings his bat hard but makes no contact.
On off, pushed towards covers for a run.
WIDE! Slower one again but way too outside off. Josh Hazlewood tries to cut but misses. Wide given.
Slower delivery on off, Hazlewood swings but fails to connect.
Length ball on off, Starc blocks it out.
Josh Hazlewood is the last man in....

OUT! CAUGHT! Just one more wicket remaining now. Back of a length, slower and on middle, Adam Zampa had to go for the big shot and he did as he tried to pull this one over the mid-wicket fence but only managed to find the fielder in the deep. Bangladesh can almost taste victory now!
Commentary.Howout: c Afif Hossain b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: On a good length outside off, Zampa swings but misses.
Touch fuller on off, Starc creams it through covers for a single.
WIDE! Full and outside off, Starc reaches out for it but misses. Wided.
Who will come into bat next? Adam Zampa is the new man in....

OUT! TAKEN! On a good length on off, Tye tries to go hard but heaves it straight down the throat of the long off fielder. Mohammad Naim takes a simple catch there. Another one bites the dust for Australia.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Naim b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Good length ball on off, Starc knocks it towards covers for a run. Singles won't help Australia here.
Length ball outside off. Tye again swings his blade but fails to connect. 31 needed from 12 balls.
SWING AND A MISS! Good length ball on off, angling away. Andrew Tye swings his bat hard but to no avail.
On a length on off, Starc plays it deep extra cover for a run.
Who will come in at number 9? It's going to be Andrew Tye!

OUT! TAKEN! Mustafizur Rahman has the last laugh! Good length ball on off, a slower one. Ashton Turner lifts it towards extra cover. Mahmudullah settles under it and grabs it without any trouble. The last recognized batter from Australia also has to depart. Bangladesh are cashing in.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Right into the slot, on off. Ashton Agar uses his feet and smacks it over the bowler's end for a boundary.
On a length on middle, Mitchell Marsh works it towards deep square leg for a signle.
Misfield! Full and outside off, Mitchell Starc paddles it towards short fine leg. The fielder there misfields and allows the ball to go past him. Three runs taken.
On a length on middle, Turner tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Slower and around off, Starc clips it to mid-wicket off the inner half for a run.
This one is bowled full outside off, a bit slower, Starc looks to drive but misses as the ball goes under his willow.
FOUR! Short one on middle, Starc pulls it past short fine leg for a much needed boundary.
Length ball around off, driven to covers.

NOT OUT! Tossed up on off, Turner looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. Nurul Hasan whips the bais off in a flash. He appeals and the square leg umpire takes it upstairs. The TV umpire first checks if there is an edge on it or not. There isn't and now he checks for the stumping. Ashton Turner has dragged his foot back well in time. Not out appears on the TV screen.

Stumping appeal has been sent upstairs. Nurul Hasan is confident that he has whipped the bails off in time but the replay shows that Ashton Turner had managed to plant his foot back in. Nasum Ahmed had bowled a lovely delivery which turned and spun away ever so slightly to beat the batsman but Turner survives.
Flatter delivery on middle, Starc drives it towards long on for one.
On middle, Turner clips it to mid-wicket for a run.
Mitchell Starc is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! That could just be the final nail in the Australian coffin! Mitchell Marsh is gone for a well made 45! Nasum Ahmed just tosses this up on middle and it was there to be hit, but it was just a bit slower and Marsh went for the big slog over the mid-wicket fence and got it high off the top-edge towards mid-wicket. Shoriful Islam ran in and took a superb diving catch to get rid of the big fish. Bangladesh in the driving seat now and Nasum Ahmed gets his fourth prey!
Commentary.Howout: c Shoriful Islam b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball outside off, Turner makes room and cuts it to sweeper cover for a run.
Bowled fuller on middle, Marsh slogs it along the ground to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter ball on middle, Marsh clips it to mid-wicket for a run. 50 runs needed from 30 balls.
Tossed up outside off, Marsh looks to cut but misses.
On middle, patted back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! Flighted delivery on middle, Marsh gets on his knee and tries to sweep it towards deep square leg. He misses his shot and gets rapped on the back foot. Shakib pleads for an LBW but the umpire is not interested. He is very confident and convinces Mahmudullah for the review. Ultra Edge shows no bat involved. The Ball Tracker shows that the impact is outside off. Marsh survives. The ball rolls on the leg side and a leg bye is taken.

There is a referral for LBW by Bangladesh. The onfield decision is Not Out! The replay shows that there is no bat involved and it's hit Turner on the back leg. The impact is clearly outside off and the onfield decision stays, NOT OUT!
On off, pushed towards extra cover for a run.
SIX! JUST OVER! Tossed up on off, Mitchell Marsh heaves it over long off for a maximum. Will that release some pressure though? Nonetheless, important 6 runs for Australia.
Tossed up on off, Turner drives it straight to the cover region.
A touch shorter, Marsh pushes ith through covers for a run.
That is very well bowled again, flighted around off and spinning away, Turner looks to dab at it but gets it off the outside edge past slip for a run.
BEAUTY! Floated on nicely around off, the balls just straightens and beats the outside edge of a defending Turner.
Who will come in next? Ashton Turner it is!

OUT! HIT-WICKET! Oh, dear! That will hurt Australia and Ashton Agar. Nasum Ahmed tosses this one up and on middle. Ashton Agar rocks back and tucks it on the leg side. He goes too deep into the crease and drags his left leg onto the stumps. He knew it straightaway and the Bangladesh players also started celebrating. It seems like everything is working in Bangladesh's favor. An unlucky dismissal for Ashton Agar really.
A dot to begin with! Quicker delivery on off, Agar cuts it to point.
Nasum Ahmed is back into the attack. So far he has figures of, 2-0-13-2!
Full and on off, Agar whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
In the air, but safe! Fuller length on off, Mitchell Marsh chips it uppishly over covers. He rotates the strike.
Good length and on middle, Marsh defends it off the front foot.
Good length ball on off, angling in. Agar steers it past point for one.
Length delivery on off, Agar taps it to point.
On a length on off, Marsh dabs it towards backward point. He crosses ends.
Mustafizur Rahman is brought back into the attack.
Flighted delivery on middle, Agar tries to push it but is early. He gets an inside edge onto the pads. 65 needed from 48 balls.
Flatter ball on off, Ashton Agar looks to cut but gets an outside edge. The ball goes past short third man and the batters collect a brace.
Loopy ball on off, Marsh steers it to deep point for a single.
Much fuller on off, Agar bunts it towards long on for a run.
Tossed up on off, Marsh eases it down to long off for a run.
FOUR! Powerful shot! Tossed up on middle, Mitchell Marsh smacks it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Bowling change. Shakib Al Hasan comes back into the attack.
On off, pushed towards covers.
Drifting on off, Agar makes room and drives it towards covers.
Floated it up on middle, Marsh shows some intent this time and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a run.
On middle, blocked out.
THREE WIDES! Huge turn there! Tossed up on leg, it spun further away. Beats everyone and the ball goes to fine leg. The batters pick up a couple.
Loopy ball on off, Agar works it towards point for a single.
Flatter ball on off, Marsh taps it to square of the wicket for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Marsh pushes it through covers for one. 80 needed from 60 balls.
On the pads, Agar glances it around the corner for a single.
WIDE! Ahmed slips it down the leg side, Agar looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Ashton Agar walks out to bat at No.6.

OUT! CAUGHT! That was a howler from the bowler to start with and then Matthew Wade played a shot that was equally poor. The ball was bowled way down leg and was spinning away, Wade goes to fetch it and pulls it straight towards short fine leg where Mustafizur Rahman takes a nice low catch. Nasum Ahmed has got the wicket of the Australian skipper who wasn't looking comfortable out there!
Commentary.Howout: c Mustafizur Rahman b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up delivery on leg, Wade reverse sweeps it to short third man.
This one is quicker and flatter on middle, Wade tucks it to mid-wicket.
Floated delivery on off, Marsh paddles it fine for a single.
Nasum Ahmed comes back into the attack.
A tad short, Marsh pushes it down the ground for one.
This time Wade does make contact with the ball as he sweeps the fuller delivery to fine leg for a run.

SAFE! What a beauty from Mahmudullah! He completely deceived Marsh with the pace and flight of the ball. Tossed it up slow on off, Marsh chips it agonisingly over the bowler's head down to long off for a run.
Flighted delivery, down the leg side, Wade tries to sweep again but gets it off the gloves and the ball hits the keeper's gloves before rolling down to short third man for a run.
A touch shorter on off, Wade checks his shot at the last moment and plays it uppishly through covers for a couple.
Tossed up outside off, Wade goes for the lap sweep but misses it onto the pads.
The skipper, Mahmudullah brings himself into the attack.
This time it's a bumper on middle, Wade pulls it fine slightly off the top-edge towards fine leg for a single.
Leg Bye! Back of a length, slower delivery on middle, Marsh is through his pull early and gets hit on the ribs. The ball rolls towards point and the batsmen get a leg bye.
Back of a length outside off, Wade cuts it off the back foot to cover for a run.
On a length around off, pushed to mid off for a single. Slight mix up as Wade does not hear Marsh's call for the single until pretty late but the fielding was not tighht and no harm is done.
Length ball on middle, Marsh gets behind the line and blocks it.
FOUR! SLAPPED! Overpitched on off, Marsh frees his arms and powerfully drives it through covers for a welcome boundary.
Shoriful Islam is brought into the attack.
This one is bowled slower and shorter, Marsh punches it off the back foot towards cover for a run.
Nicely flighted on middle, Wade goes on his knees and paddles it fine to fine leg for a single.
Tossed up around off, worked to sweeper cover for one.
Hasan bowls this one quicker and flatter outside off, Marsh is caught in the crease as he misses the cut.
A bit fuller on off, Marsh pushes it through covers for a couple.
Arm ball, darted in on middle and leg, Wade makes room and drives it through point for a couple.
Mahedi Hasan is back into the attack. His figures read 2-0-10-1.
Another beauty to end the over! Pitched up and slower, angling away from the batsman, Marsh looks to push at it but gets deceived by the lack off pace. Australia are 28/3 at the end of the Powerplay!
Length ball around off, slower but nips back in sharply, Wade gets cramped and gets the inside edge down to short fine leg for a single.
This time Mustafizur Rahman bangs one into the deck, Wade looks to pull hard but the ball hurries onto him and he bottom edges the ball back onto the deck.
Back of a length on middle, worked to mid-wicket for a run by Marsh.
Slower one, drifting down the leg side, Marsh looks to glance it but gets it off the pads to the keeper.
Length ball outside off to start with from Mustafizur Rahman, Marsh looks to drive but misses.
Bowling change. Mustafizur Rahman is into the attack.
Loopy ball on off, patted back to the bowler.
Full and on middle, Marsh flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
On middle, Marsh is solid in his defense.
FOUR! Important runs for Australia! Loopy ball outside off, Mitchell Marsh sees the width. He takes advantage of it and carves it past point for a boundary.
Flatter ball on off, Marsh steers it to point.
Nearly got another! Slower and on of, the ball stayed a little low. Mitchell Marsh digs it out to point just in time.
Short and on middle, Marsh nudges it to mid on for a run.
FOUR! Quicker ball on off, Mitchell Marsh guides it off the under edge towards third man for a boundary. Doesn't matter how these runs come as long as they come.
Loopy ball outside off, Wade pushes it through covers for a single.
Flatter ball on middle, blocked out.
Excellent running between the wickets! Tossed up on middle, Matthew Wade hangs back and nudges it towards deep mid-wicket. He pushes hard for the second and gets it comfortably.
Floated it up on middle, Wade blocks it out.
Change of ends for Mahedi Hasan.
Loopy ball on middle, Wade pushes it in front of mid on for a quick single.
Slower through the air on off, Wade drives it to mid off.
On off, pushed towards covers.
WIDE! Shakib sprays this one down the leg, Wade misses his flick. Wided.
Tossed up on off, Matthew Wade tries to reverse sweep but gets hit on the glvoes.
Loopy ball on off, Wade tucks it on the leg side.
Who will come in next? It's the skipper, Matthew Wade!

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Flatter and quicker delivery on off, Moises Henriques gets down on his knee and tries to sweep it across. The ball goes off the inside edge and goes through his bat and pad to rattle the stumps. Nutmeg him completely. Australia in all sorts of trouble. Shakib Al Hasan gets a wicket off his first delivery. Moises Henriques has to walk back to the shed now.
Shakib Al Hasan comes into the attack.
New batsman! Moises Henriques is the new man in.
On middle, Marsh blocks it out.
Tossed up on middle, Moises Henriques clips it on the leg side for a single.

There is a stumping referral and the umpire has taken it upstairs. Josh Philippe had leaned forward a bit too much and the replay shows that he did have his back foot planted but it wasn't inside the batting crease. The third umpire gives it OUT in a flash but Josh Philippe is already on his way back to the pavillion. This is just the start Bangladesh needed!

OUT! STUMPED! Beautiful piece of spin bowling from Nasum Ahmed as he just tosses this one on a length around off and lets the ball do the magic. The ball turns sharply away from Josh Philippe who put a huge stride forward in order to block it. Nurul Hasan behind the stumps whips off the bails in a flash and Philippe starts walking. The umpire does go upstairs and we can see that the back foot was on the line and Australia have been rocked twice early on!
Commentary.Howout: st Nurul Hasan b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter one on middle, Philippe flicks it through square leg for a couple.
SIX! Short and punished by Josh Philippe! This time Philippe rocks back and whacks the shorter one over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
A touch shorter, forces Josh Philippe to go back into his crease and push it towards mid on.
Who will bowl from the other end? Nasum Ahmed it is!
Tossed up on the pads, Marsh tucks it on the leg side. An excellent first love from Mahedi Hasan. A wicket and two runs from it.
Loopy ball on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up and drifting on middle, Marsh flicks it uppishly to short mid-wicket. It lands just short of the fielder there.
Tossed up on middle, Phillipe works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on off, Marsh clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Who will come in at number 3? Mitchell Marsh walks out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! A dream start for Bangladesh! Flatter and quicker from Mahedi Hasan as he bowls this on middle, attacking the stumps. Alex Carey hangs back and tries to cut it to the off side but misses it completely. The ball goes through and ricochets the stumps. Mahedi Hasan is delighted as he jumps and punches the air. A perfect start for the hosts. Alex Carey walks back disappointed.
